name: Singapore

ownershipFlags.label: At least 30% owned by Singapore Citizens or PRs

ownershipHelp: Tick if Singapore Citizens and/or Permanent Residents own at least 30% of the business, counted through to the individual owners. Most Enterprise Singapore grants and loans (EDGE, Energy Efficiency Grant, Enterprise Financing Scheme) require it.

ownershipFlags.local_30: Sekurang-kurangnya 30% milik warganegara atau PR Singapura

ms.ownershipHelp: Tandakan jika warganegara dan/atau Penduduk Tetap Singapura memiliki sekurang-kurangnya 30% perniagaan ini. Kebanyakan geran dan pinjaman Enterprise Singapore (EDGE, Energy Efficiency Grant, Enterprise Financing Scheme) memerlukannya.
